fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-07-17 around 21:50 hrs, it was reported that Nithya Selvi was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore. The complainant noted the registration number TN-38-YY-1028 of a black car. A witness, Dinesh Subramani, reachable on 9000000212, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place. A car was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: altercation, street dispute, main street, night, car, witness statement, photograph, witness
